UPDATE o
    SET CompletionDate = GETDATE()
    FROM Orders o
    INNER JOIN inserted i ON o.OrderID = i.OrderID
    INNER JOIN deleted d ON o.OrderID = d.OrderID
    WHERE i.StatusID = 3      -- Completed
      AND d.StatusID <> 3
      AND o.CompletionDate IS NULL

UPDATE o
    SET o.StatusID = 3   -- Completed
    FROM Orders o
    INNER JOIN inserted i ON o.OrderID = i.OrderID
    INNER JOIN OrderCosts oc ON o.OrderID = oc.OrderID
    WHERE (oc.BaseCost + oc.ComplicationCost + oc.FabricCost + oc.UrgencyCost) <=
          (SELECT SUM(Amount) FROM CashRegister WHERE OrderID = o.OrderID)

INSERT INTO CashRegister (OrderID, PaymentDate, Amount)

SELECT TOP 10
        o.OrderID,
        c.CustomerName,
        ISNULL(oc.BaseCost + oc.FabricCost + oc.ComplicationCost + oc.UrgencyCost, 0) AS TotalCost,
        ISNULL(SUM(cr.Amount), 0) AS TotalPaid,
        ISNULL(oc.BaseCost + oc.FabricCost + oc.ComplicationCost + oc.UrgencyCost, 0) - ISNULL(SUM(cr.Amount), 0) AS Balance

    HAVING ISNULL(oc.BaseCost + oc.FabricCost + oc.ComplicationCost + oc.UrgencyCost, 0) - ISNULL(SUM(cr.Amount), 0) > 0
    ORDER BY o.OrderID DESC
